content.short: Splits yield into a protected senior tranche and a leveraged junior tranche, starting with USDe.
content.description: Strata divides the return from a yield source into two tokens. The senior tranche, srUSDe, is an overcollateralized synthetic dollar with a minimum yield and protection against strategy losses. The junior tranche, jrUSDe, takes first loss in exchange for leveraged upside, acting as a market-priced insurance fund. The first products are built on Ethena's USDe, with more strategies planned.
content.meta: Strata tranches USDe yield into protected senior srUSDe and higher-return junior jrUSDe that absorbs first loss.
